name: Code Candy Hover Pill Menu
useWhen: A project needs a compact pill menu where labels reveal only on hover or keyboard focus without moving on its own.
implementationNotes: Hover and focus are the only expansion triggers.
Keep icon buttons keyboard focusable and labeled.
Use fixed dimensions so expanded labels do not shift surrounding layout.
Use this as a component pattern, not as a full page template.
reducedMotion: Keep hover/focus state changes instant or very short, with labels still accessible to assistive tech.
avoid: expanding menus that cover primary content
